observations: The front gable crown and shoulders are lowered, with a smaller recessed timber diaphragm instead of the old full-height blank triangle.
The upper hip eave is higher/narrower, and two white frieze bands are thinner grey fields.
The genuine roof detail reveals bare grey vertical gap-fillers above the earlier upper bearing row.
Timber fascia hides too much of the front ceramic end course, so the blue-grey roof edge is visually weak.
The borrowed full ceramic mask has inappropriate eyes/teeth for the family-medallion crest visible in Ref03.
nextCorrection: Retain the curved timber parts but raise the upper receiver beam and its assembly to the new roof underside.
Use short closed ceramic eave tails ending ahead of the timber lip.
Use only the closed lobed ceramic backing with a real medallion, omitting the face parts.
Use a dedicated darker timber material inside the recessed gable.
